content: Competitive positioning: Klaviyo = ecommerce-first, email+SMS depth, low engineering lift, good free/entry tier, weak native push/in-app. Braze/Customer.io/Iterable = developer-first, true omnichannel (email/SMS/push/in-app), stronger event-driven segmentation, but require ongoing engineering investment and enterprise pricing. For an email-only B2C product the relevant bar is Klaviyo-class depth (flows+segmentation+broadcast), not full omnichannel orchestration.
